The AEO2025's reference case is based on the assumption that laws and regulations in effect as of December 2024 will continue through 2050. While the outlook does not focus specifically on bitumen, its forecasts for crude oil prices offer context for potential bitumen price trends, as crude oil is a key feedstock. A DOE spokesperson noted that the report reflects policies of the previous administration and not the policy changes of the current one.
